subject: Next steps: deployment routing and SOC2/BAA evidence for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Meridian Security <security@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T16:02:00-05:00
Subject: Post-call recap + options matrix (hosted / dedicated / private)

Alex — thanks for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Requirement highlights you shared: handling PHI, BAA in place, SOC2 Type II evidence required for audit, and potential data residency needs for a subset of records.
- Product options we discussed: Hosted API (fastest to market, needs BAA + strict access controls), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools, good middle ground — supports a BAA and network isolation), Private VPC / on-prem (full control, longer lead time and higher ops cost).

Attached: deployment-options-matrix.xlsx (breakdown by security controls, provisioning time, cost delta) and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (our SOC2 scope and artifacts we can share).

Action items I propose:
1) Confirm whether Meridian needs on-prem for any datasets or whether VPC/Dedicated is acceptable for now.
2) Share Meridian's list of audit artifacts your team will require (if you have a template, please attach).
3) I'll loop in our security lead and solutions engineering to outline evidence and provisioning timelines.

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive next week to walk through the matrix and a draft BAA? If yes, what time zones work best?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: deployment-options-matrix.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + options matrix (hosted / dedicated / private)

Rafael — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We will be processing PHI for one pilot workflow. Our legal/compliance team requires a BAA in place before any PHI is sent to a vendor.
- For SOC2, we need Type II evidence for the last 12 months (control descriptions, recent audit report, and evidence artifacts like change control logs). If some artifacts are restricted, we can accept redacted copies with a confidentiality agreement.
- Data residency: primary storage must remain in the US; we may explore an EU region later.

Attached is a short requirements spreadsheet (meridian-reqs.xlsx) showing the audit artifacts they typically request.

Preference: we'd like to evaluate Dedicated capacity first (it looks like the best tradeoff). If Dedicated can meet the BAA and provide the SOC2 artifacts, we can avoid the longer on-prem project for the pilot.

Available for a follow-up on Tue/Wed next week afternoon EST.

— Alex

Subject: RE: Fwd: Post-call recap + options matrix — request for security provisioning plan

Rafael / Marissa / Alex — high-level recommendation and constraints from security: 

Recommendation summary:
- Short term (pilot): Dedicated capacity with a BAA. Dedicated provides network isolation and we can provide the SOC2 Type II report and a set of supporting artifacts (control descriptions, select audit logs, change control summaries). It minimizes customer-side ops while meeting legal requirements.
- Medium term (if Meridian wants full control): Private VPC with cross-connect or on-prem. This is viable but adds ~8–12 weeks of engineering + network coordination.
- Hosted API: acceptable only if Meridian can accept strict scoping of PHI processing (tokenization/pseudonymization) and the BAA; otherwise not recommended for initial PHI pilot.

Evidence we can provide today (summary): 
- SOC2 Type II report (latest cycle) — PDF summary (we can provide full report under NDA).
- Control matrix and selected artifacts: change control logs (redacted), incident response plan, access control lists, and system architecture diagrams.
- BAA: redwood-baa-draft.docx attached for legal review.

Provisioning timeline (Dedicated):
- Initial account + reserved pool allocation: 3–5 business days after contract and baseline security review.
- Network isolation and VPC peering setup: additional 3–7 business days depending on firewall/peering approvals.
- Validation and test run: 2 business days.
Total expected (typical case): 8–14 business days from signed order. See attached redwood-dedicated-provisioning-timeline.pdf for a sample schedule.

Next steps: Rafael, propose a technical deep-dive next Tue/Wed to walk the Meridian infra and legal teams through the artifacts. I can join to review the SOC2 artifacts and answer technical security controls questions.

— Marcus Lin
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-baa-draft.docx, redwood-dedicated-provisioning-timeline.pdf
